text:
She doesn't want your love. She wants your absence.

It's 11 p.m. You sent the third text she hasn't answered. You're planning the next gift. The next surprise.

She's showing her friend your messages. Not because you're a joke. Because desperation is never attractive.

She can pay her own bills. She can fill her own weekends. SHE DOESN'T NEED ANOTHER FAN. SHE NEEDS A MAN SHE'S AFRAID TO LOSE.

Stop performing. Start walking away from what doesn't walk toward you.
caption:
Most men destroy attraction without knowing it. Dating psychology and discipline teach the same lesson: desperation repels, self mastery attracts.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
